[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"- **Live streaming cards** — tool calls, reasoning, markdown, and tables stream in as the agent work"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"s.
- **One-tap control panel** — `/panel` renders the full command palette as buttons; no command sy"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"ntax to remember, and each button is the exact equivalent of typing the command.
- **In-card approva"},{"id":"p31s4","text":"ls & questions** — approve a permission escalation or answer the agent's questions in the chat.
- **"},{"id":"p31s5","text":"Sessions survive restarts** — a chat's session and its working directory are persisted across daemon"},{"id":"p31s6","text":" restarts; `/sessions` lists, resumes, renames, archives, and exports them.
- **One-QR quick setup**"},{"id":"p31s7","text":" — a single Feishu QR scan creates and configures the app (bot profile, scopes, event subscriptions,"},{"id":"p31s8","text":" credentials) and writes the dsh profile.
- **Files in both directions** — images, files, videos, an"},{"id":"p31s9","text":"d rich-text posts you send land in the workspace as plain files the agent reads by path; the agent c"},{"id":"p31s10","text":"an send workspace files and images back to the chat.
- **Message queue & steering** — messages sent "},{"id":"p31s11","text":"while a turn is running queue visibly; edit, delete, or steer them into the running turn.
- **Files "},{"id":"p31s12","text":"a turn produced** — appear as chips at the bottom of the card; tap one to receive it in the chat.
- "},{"id":"p31s13","text":"**Card stats & diagnostics** — turns, tool calls, tokens, and current context-window occupancy on th"},{"id":"p31s14","text":"e card; `/feishu-status` shows connection and session diagnostics, and stays usable mid-turn.
- **Gr"},{"id":"p31s15","text":"oups & mentions** — @-mention the bot; error notices, approvals, and questions @ the requester.
- **"},{"id":"p31s16","text":"Reactions, allowlists, reminders, export** — reaction ack, `allowedChats` / `allowedUsers`, schedule"},{"id":"p31s17","text":"d reminders, and session-log files."}],"truncated":true}
